passages.text: Now when all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings along the coast heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the Israelites until they had crossed over, their hearts melted and their spirits failed for fear of the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD dried up the waters of the Jordan River.
He did this in front of the Israelites.
He kept the river dry until the Israelites crossed over.
All the Amorite kings lived west of the Jordan River.
All the Canaanite kings lived along the coast.
These kings heard what the LORD had done.
They heard that the LORD dried up the Jordan River for the Israelites.
When they heard this, their hearts melted with fear.
They lost all courage because of the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י כִשְׁמֹ֣עַ כָּל־ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֡י אֲשֶׁר֩ בְּעֵ֨בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֜ן יָ֗מָּה וְכָל־ מַלְכֵ֤י הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַיָּ֔ם אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹבִ֨ישׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ מֵ֧י הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן מִפְּנֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־ עָבְרָנוּ וַיִּמַּ֣ס לְבָבָ֗ם וְלֹא־ הָ֨יָה בָ֥ם עוֹד֙ ר֔וּחַ מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, “Make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel once again.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua at that time.
The LORD gave Joshua a command.
The LORD told Joshua to make flint knives.
The LORD told Joshua to circumcise the sons of Israel again.
passages.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עֲשֵׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ חַֽרְב֣וֹת צֻרִ֑ים וְשׁ֛וּב מֹ֥ל אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at Gibeath-haaraloth.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
God told Joshua to circumcise the sons of Israel again.
Joshua obeyed God.
Joshua made knives from flint.
Joshua used the flint knives to circumcise the sons of Israel.
Joshua did this at a place called Gibeath-haaraloth.
passages.original: וַיַּעַשׂ־ ל֥וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ חַֽרְב֣וֹת צֻרִ֑ים וַיָּ֙מָל֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־ גִּבְעַ֖ת הָעֲרָלֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Now this is why Joshua circumcised them: All those who came out of Egypt—all the men of war—had died on the journey in the wilderness after they had left Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
God told Joshua to circumcise the sons of Israel.
Joshua obeyed God.
Joshua circumcised the sons of Israel.
This is the reason Joshua circumcised them.
All the men who left Egypt were men of war.
All these men had died.
They died during the journey in the wilderness.
They died after they left Egypt.
passages.original: וְזֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־ מָ֣ל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם הַיֹּצֵא֩ מִמִּצְרַ֨יִם הַזְּכָרִ֜ים כֹּ֣ל׀ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה מֵ֤תוּ בַמִּדְבָּר֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Though all who had come out were circumcised, none of those born in the wilderness on the journey from Egypt had been circumcised.
passages.sermon:
All the people who came out of Egypt were circumcised.
These people left Egypt.
They had already received circumcision.
But some people were born later.
These people were born in the wilderness.
They were born during the journey from Egypt.
None of these people born in the wilderness were circumcised.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ מֻלִ֣ים הָי֔וּ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם הַיֹּֽצְאִ֑ים וְכָל־ הָ֠עָם הַיִּלֹּדִ֨ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר בַּדֶּ֛רֶךְ בְּצֵאתָ֥ם מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם לֹא־ מָֽלוּ׃

passages.text: For the Israelites had wandered in the wilderness forty years, until all the nation’s men of war who had come out of Egypt had died, since they did not obey the LORD. So the LORD vowed never to let them see the land He had sworn to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites wandered in the wilderness for forty years.
They wandered until all the men of war from Egypt died.
These men had come out of Egypt.
They did not obey the LORD.
The LORD had sworn an oath to them.
He swore they would not see the land.
The LORD had promised this land to their fathers.
This land flows with milk and honey.
passages.original: כִּ֣י׀ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה הָלְכ֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ בַּמִּדְבָּר֒ עַד־ תֹּ֨ם כָּל־ הַגּ֜וֹי אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֞י הַרְאוֹתָ֣ם אֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהוָ֤ה לַֽאֲבוֹתָם֙ לָ֣תֶת לָ֔נוּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃

passages.text: And Joshua raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones he circumcised. Until this time they were still uncircumcised, since they had not been circumcised along the way.
passages.sermon:
Joshua led the people of Israel after Moses died.
The men who left Egypt had all died in the wilderness.
Their sons took their place.
Joshua raised up these sons to lead the nation.
These sons had not been circumcised during the journey in the wilderness.
Joshua circumcised them.
They were uncircumcised until this time because no one had circumcised them along the way.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶם֙ הֵקִ֣ים תַּחְתָּ֔ם אֹתָ֖ם מָ֣ל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כִּי־ עֲרֵלִ֣ים הָי֔וּ כִּ֛י לֹא־ מָ֥לוּ אוֹתָ֖ם בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: And after all the nation had been circumcised, they stayed there in the camp until they were healed.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
Joshua led the Israelites.
Joshua circumcised all the Israelites who had not been circumcised.
After every Israelite man was circumcised, the people stopped moving.
They remained in their camp.
They stayed there until they were healed.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י כַּאֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֥מּוּ כָל־ הַגּ֖וֹי לְהִמּ֑וֹל וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּ֛ם בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה עַ֥ד חֲיוֹתָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” So that place has been called Gilgal to this day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD said, "Today I have taken away the shame of Egypt from you."
Joshua named that place Gilgal.
People still call it Gilgal today.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַיּ֗וֹם גַּלּ֛וֹתִי אֶת־ חֶרְפַּ֥ת מִצְרַ֖יִם מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֞א שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ גִּלְגָּ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while the Israelites were camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, they kept the Passover.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites camped at Gilgal.
Gilgal was on the plains of Jericho.
The Israelites stayed there.
On the fourteenth day of the month, in the evening, they kept the Passover.
passages.original: וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּגִּלְגָּ֑ל וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֶת־ הַפֶּ֡סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֥וֹם לַחֹ֛דֶשׁ בָּעֶ֖רֶב בְּעַֽרְב֥וֹת יְרִיחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The day after the Passover, on that very day, they ate unleavened bread and roasted grain from the produce of the land.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites camped at Gilgal.
The Israelites celebrated the Passover.
The next day was after the Passover.
On that very day, the Israelites ate food from the land.
They ate unleavened bread.
They ate roasted grain.
This food came from the produce of the land.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אכְל֜וּ מֵעֲב֥וּר הָאָ֛רֶץ מִמָּֽחֳרַ֥ת הַפֶּ֖סַח מַצּ֣וֹת וְקָל֑וּי בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: And the day after they had eaten from the produce of the land, the manna ceased. There was no more manna for the Israelites, so that year they began to eat the crops of the land of Canaan.
passages.sermon:
God provided manna to the Israelites in the wilderness.
The Israelites ate manna every day before entering Canaan.
The Israelites entered the land of Canaan.
They ate food from the land of Canaan.
The next day, the manna stopped.
God did not give manna to the Israelites anymore.
That year, the Israelites ate the crops of the land of Canaan.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁבֹּ֨ת הַמָּ֜ן מִֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת בְּאָכְלָם֙ מֵעֲב֣וּר הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹא־ הָ֥יָה ע֛וֹד לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מָ֑ן וַיֹּאכְל֗וּ מִתְּבוּאַת֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַהִֽיא׃ס

passages.text: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with a drawn sword in His hand. Joshua approached Him and asked, “Are You for us or for our enemies?”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was near Jericho.
Joshua looked up.
Joshua saw a man standing in front of him.
The man held a drawn sword in his hand.
Joshua walked toward the man.
Joshua spoke to the man.
Joshua asked, “Are you for us?”
Joshua also asked, “Or are you for our enemies?”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּֽהְי֣וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ בִּירִיחוֹ֒ וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּה־ אִישׁ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד לְנֶגְדּ֔וֹ וְחַרְבּ֥וֹ שְׁלוּפָ֖ה בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֵלָיו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ הֲלָ֥נוּ אַתָּ֖ה אִם־ לְצָרֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: “Neither,” He replied. “I have now come as Commander of the LORD’s army.” Then Joshua fell facedown in reverence and asked Him, “What does my Lord have to say to His servant?”
passages.sermon:
A man stood in front of Joshua near Jericho.
This man held a drawn sword in his hand.
Joshua asked the man, “Are you for us or for our enemies?”
The man answered, “Neither.”
He said, “I have now come as Commander of the LORD’s army.”
Joshua fell facedown to the ground.
Joshua showed reverence.
Joshua asked the man, “What does my Lord have to say to His servant?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ לֹ֗א כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י שַׂר־ צְבָֽא־ יְהוָ֖ה עַתָּ֣ה בָ֑אתִי וַיִּפֹּל֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ אֶל־ פָּנָ֥יו אַ֙רְצָה֙ וַיִּשְׁתָּ֔חוּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ מָ֥ה אֲדֹנִ֖י מְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ עַבְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The Commander of the LORD’s army replied, “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.” And Joshua did so.
passages.sermon:
The Commander of the LORD’s army spoke to Joshua.
He said, “Take off your sandals.”
He said, “The place where you are standing is holy.”
Joshua took off his sandals.
Joshua obeyed the Commander.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ שַׂר־ צְבָ֨א יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ שַׁל־ נַֽעַלְךָ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔ךָ כִּ֣י הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד עָלָ֖יו קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֑וּא וַיַּ֥עַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ כֵּֽן׃
